scope: Read-only delta review and AST parse only. This script was not executed: no build, test suite, namespace, database, Docker, service or mount action.

closed_findings.resolution: All test/race/vet/build commands now use the existing execute_bounded helper, which starts a new session and always TERM/KILLs only its process group before returning, even on a successful parent exit.

The exact prepared scope and original acceptance/config/binary hashes are validated through launcher.inputs(); bin/evidence/new output directory chains use private nofollow validation. Both new directories use exclusive mkdir. The original fixed three regular single-link binaries are recorded and checked unchanged afterward.

closed_findings.previous: Source stable but not proven equal to fixed revision
closed_findings.resolution: Before any repository Python import, all tracked non-evidence regular single-link bytes are compared against the immutable revision Git blobs. After commands a second full blob comparison and stored manifest, HEAD equality and clean status are required.

other_boundaries: Minimal explicit Go environment has no FORGE or provider key variables, and Go module/proxy/sumdb/toolchain network fetch is disabled. HOME is the private child scope only.
New binaries are written only under bin/<full revision>; old binary paths are never build targets. Existing partial output causes a hard failure without deletion or retry.
Intent saves script/go hashes, version, source revision and original hashes; runner and worker embedded build metadata must report exact revision and vcs.modified=false before final passed=true.
A command nonzero/timeout saves failed results and leaves logs/partial files. Build metadata or final invariant failure leaves the evidence directory without passed=true.
limits: Read-only review does not constitute actual build or runtime acceptance.
The acceptance test binary has no equivalent embedded VCS assertion; its provenance is the recorded fixed input hashes, exact go test -c command, and resulting byte hash.
This build helper does not run test-list. The already reviewed mapped launcher still requires the exact selected test entry and final report before considering a real phase successful.
The owned private checkout and scope must remain quiescent during the operation; this is an operator fixture, not a hostile same-UID race boundary.
